inbox.body: One desk for comments, DMs, and mentions across connected channels — still on the list.

analytics.body: Reach, engagement, and growth in one calm read — no dashboards that shout.

insights.body: Signals you can actually act on. Not vanity charts — clear next steps.

reports.body: Share the wins automatically. Weekly summaries your team will actually read.

audience.body: Understand who is really watching — segments, habits, and quiet patterns.

experiments.body: Test hooks, thumbnails, and timing. Learn fast, repeat what works.
